title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wetail AB…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the WooCommerce Fortnox Integration plugin by Wetail AB, affecting versions up to 4.8.1. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 6.5, indicating a medium severity level.
